newsitem.title: USA: First Team Sports plans Austria subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: First Team Sports plans Austria subsidiary.

text.p: First Team Sports Inc said Tuesday it planned to open a subsidiary in Austria during the second quarter of fiscal year 1998.

First Team, maker of UltraWheels in-line skates, said the subsidiary, First Team Sports GmbH, will be managed by Kent Brunner, vice president of finance, and Lukas Piffl, a managing director who served as European sales consultant since 1993. The unit will be located in Graz, Austria.

"By opening a European subsidiary, we can be more responsive to the needs of our European retailers and maintain better control of the distribution of our UltraWheels products," said John Egart, president and chief executive of First Team Sports. "In addition, because we will be closer to the market, we can gear our products and marketing programs more specifically to their needs."
